segments.context: Onyx Coffee Lab · United StatesCold Brew (US whole bean)Onyx Cold Brew is a purpose-roasted, expressive-dark whole-bean option for a household that regularly steeps or cold-drips coffee and likes a cocoa-and-date brief. The current roaster page gives a Toddy gallon start, while its Colombia/Caturra/washed summary conflicts with a story describing a rotating washed Ethiopia and Colombia blend. Treat the exact origin mix as unconfirmed for a future bag. Onyx's 0 mg caffeine module also conflicts with a regular coffee listing, so this is not a decaf recommendation. Coffeedant has not brewed or tasted it. Buy a practical size, inspect its roast date and judge the actual cold cup before bulk.Updated 2026-11-12 · Check current US whole-bean size and delivered total at November 12, 2026
